propositions: Recovery must classify and complete interrupted retirement states where one exact identity exists as both live and tombstoned without guessing across mismatched identities.

Create recovery logic must be extracted to binding_recovery.py preserving existing labels, immutable behavior, three-miss plus 3600-second grace, and recover_pending_bindings signature for existing call sites.

Retirement completion must only proceed when tombstone, live forward entry, and live reverse entry all agree on exact local_id and Jira key; mismatches or corruption must abort safely and retain evidence.
Completion operation must remove redundant live forward/reverse pair while retaining tombstone; repeated completion must be idempotent with no write.
Keyed pending recovery must perform no search; keyless pending recovery must still require both three misses and 3600-second threshold with one entry failure not stopping others.
Pre-existing create-recovery invocation gate must remain behaviorally unchanged: UNSCOPED-passes-only guarded solely by `if not scoped_ids` with no new write-bearing or scope conditions attached.
